sources.inspection: Selected official molecular and atomic records inspected; both coefficient intervals match the frozen screening. Official 300 K lower bounds retained where present; no extrapolation to 298.15 K. NASA_R=8.314510 is distinct from SI_R.
Exact one-bar neutral monomer table inspected; formula checked against the frozen map. No dimer, ion or condensed-phase substitution.
Full Gurvich 1997 evaluation text sections2.2.1-2.2.2 pp1046-1058 inspected, especially Table23 and selected formation enthalpy. Original ancestral experimental papers not independently inspected.
Official distributed partition table inspected and compared as a finite rovibrational sum; not a full thermodynamic convergence certificate.
Mass, symmetry weights and stated line-list/partition limits inspected; disagreements are preserved, not silently corrected.
First ten J=0 records only, read by streaming a small compressed prefix. Ground energy zero and total weights8 confirm the paper normalization; not a full state-sum recomputation.
Full author-hosted published article inspected, sections2/3, Table1 and Figures1/2. Opacity lower-state cutoff and total-PF convergence are different diagnostics. No full paper archived.

redistribution: Only numerical tables, selected public NASA records, short state excerpts, source metadata and derived facts are archived. Full articles remain external.
